key_impacts: PHIVOLCS issued tsunami alert level 3 calling for immediate coastal evacuations
Approximately 80% of residents in surveyed barangays evacuated after the alert
No significant tsunami observed and no damages reported
Communication delays and failures reported, including power cuts and a misinforming radio broadcast
evidence_snippets: On 31 August 2012 a strong earthquake occurred east of Eastern Samar; PHIVOLCS issued a tsunami alert shortly after.
All surveyed barangays had about 80% of residents evacuating after the alert.
No significant wave appeared and no damages were observed.
missing_information: Exact list of evacuated municipalities/ barangays not fully enumerated
Wave heights not quantified; detailed impact numbers beyond evacuations are limited
